setting.description: Athens in 416 BCE, days before the Assembly decides what to do about an island that refused to join its empire.

visible.role: A young citizen asked to speak for the hard-line position in the Assembly.

attractors: The participant becomes more persuasive on behalf of a position they reject.
invariants: The position is argued in its strongest form by intelligent people with real reasons.
The participant's arguments have consequences for people who are not in the room.
